## Description

Update `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md` to add Step 4.5 between the reviewer dispatch (Step 4) and record-review.sh (Step 5). This step dispatches `code-reviewer-verifier` as a Claude Code sub-agent with bounded Bash allowlist and applies its rulings to the findings before record-review.sh runs.

## Done Definitions

- REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md contains Step 4.5 with:
  - Clear placement: AFTER all reviewer + overlay dispatches complete, BEFORE record-review.sh (Step 5)
  - Minor findings bypass: only critical/important/fragile findings are passed to verifier
  - Sub-agent dispatch spec: `subagent_type: "dso:code-reviewer-verifier"`, allowed tools: `Read`, `Glob`, Bash with allowlist `["grep", "stat", "ls", "file"]` only
  - File reads: `git show <reviewed_sha>:<path>` pattern, NOT live working tree (SHA captured at Step 4 dispatch time)
  - Ruling routing: confirm → proceed unchanged, downgrade-to-minor → set severity "minor", drop → remove finding before record-review.sh
  - Failure handling: verifier timeout/error → fail-open (log warning, proceed with findings unchanged)
  - Cross-path contract: document that `git show <sha>:<path>` may not find deleted files at SHA; in that case emit `verifier_status: failed` and pass through (same as CI path, ensuring S7's ≥95% equivalence)
- Running `tests/workflows/test-review-workflow-verifier-dispatch.sh` exits 0 after this task

## File Impact

- `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md` — UPDATED (Step 4.5 added)

## Testing Mode

GREEN — makes T1 tests pass
